problem_title: C4-free subgraphs of the hypercube Q_n
description: Paired comparison: does C4-free constraint shift the Poisson-to-GOE spectral transition (entropic cooling hypothesis)?
hypothesis: C4-free constraint suppresses spectral entropy, shifting p_c upward (more edges needed for GOE).
falsification_criterion: If p_c(C4-free) <= p_c(unconstrained) for n >= 5, hypothesis is falsified.

method.ensemble_A: Bernoulli edge retention at probability p
method.ensemble_B: Sequential random C4-free insertion thinned to matched edge count

overall_verdict: INCONCLUSIVE — mixed or neutral results across n values
anti_artifact_note: All values are Monte Carlo outputs. 'Cooling' is metaphor, not physics. Positive Δp_c = C4-free needs more edges for GOE = spectral suppression.

data_integrity.note: All values from Monte Carlo with stated seed. No fabricated data.
